description:
Cast Viscid Lemures by paying {4}{B}
When Viscid Lemures enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscid Lemures by paying {0}, giving it -1/-0 and swampwalk until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the difference between Viscid Lemures' power and toughness.
